title: Keyboard Manager interrupting "Copy as Path Shortcut"

status.label: Needs focused investigation
status.detail: With Keyboard Manager enabled, Ctrl+Shift+C reportedly stops working as Explorer's Copy as path shortcut even though it is not directly remapped.

next_action.label: Reproduce and review proposal
next_action.reason: Keyboard Manager dispatches keyboard events through multiple remap handlers; the report does not include the mappings needed to identify which path consumes the shortcut.

judgment.rationale: Keyboard Manager dispatches keyboard events through multiple remap handlers; the report does not include the mappings needed to identify which path consumes the shortcut.
evidence: The reporter says the shortcut is not mapped over.
A duplicate label and bot suggestion #47978 do not establish that the exact shortcut and configuration are covered.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the reported behavior and review the scoped proposal before implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: Keyboard Manager dispatches keyboard events through multiple remap handlers; the report does not include the mappings needed to identify which path consumes the shortcut.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve an unmapped Explorer Copy as path shortcut
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: a remap involving a constituent key or an unmatched shortcut handler suppresses part of Ctrl+Shift+C; the mapping and failing handler remain unknown.
plan: Reproduce using the reporter's mappings and compare with an empty mapping set.
Trace key-down and key-up events through the matching handlers.
Correct the demonstrated unintended suppression and add regression coverage alongside mapped-shortcut behavior.
verification: Ctrl+Shift+C copies the selected path with Keyboard Manager enabled and intended remaps continue to work.

reproduce.title: Preserve an unmapped Explorer Copy as path shortcut
prerequisites: Windows Explorer and Keyboard Manager enabled
setup: Select a disposable file and configure the reporter's mappings if available.
steps: Press Ctrl+Shift+C and paste the clipboard into a text editor.
Repeat with Keyboard Manager disabled and with an empty mapping set.
Compare key and shortcut mappings involving Ctrl, Shift, or C.
reproduce.expected_result: Copy as path succeeds without changing configured remap behavior.
